title: Invariant test: walker never surfaces rcf/define/ files
description: One-scenario test that seeds a fresh project (initProject), writes rcf/define/freeze.json, the four ledger files and a bug-bait req-999.json under rcf/define/, then runs walkTree and asserts no error path starts with rcf/define/ and no such file lands in tree.byId. The invariant is what keeps the sidecars out of every existing tree consumer (proposal 2026-09-22 section 2.1).
